evidence_summary: The test `test_poc_fl001_imbalanced_deposit_inflates_check_balance` demonstrates that a large one-sided deposit into the Curve OETH/WETH pool inflates `get_virtual_price()`, causing `checkBalance()` to overstate the strategy's TVL. After adding 500 WETH in a single imbalanced deposit, the virtual price rises from 1.000 to ~1.004 (a ~0.4% increase), and checkBalance overstates TVL by the corresponding amount proportional to the strategy's LP holdings. `test_poc_fl001_tvm_overstatement_magnitude` confirms that 10 sequential 100 WETH imbalanced deposits produce >10 BPS TVL overstatement. `test_poc_fl001_fix_reference_time_averaged_price` shows that the actual virtual_price increase (~0.4% = ~40 BPS) exceeds a 0.3% circuit-breaker threshold, confirming a TWAP or circuit breaker would detect and prevent the manipulation.
